wrap_gym_env: wrap an OpenAI Gym environment to use as a dm_env environment with GymWrapper
convert_gym_space: convert a Gym space like Box or Discrete to a dm_env spec using _convert_to_spec
reset_gym_wrapper: reset a GymWrapper environment and return a dm_env restart timestep with observation
step_gym_wrapper: step a GymWrapper environment with an action and return a dm_env timestep
wrap_gym_atari: wrap a Gym Atari environment with GymAtariAdapter to expose lives count as an observation
